description: This file defines the `ThingConflictException`, a custom exception class used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to signal conflicts related to 'Thing' objects when they already exist in the system. It includes constructors, builder pattern, and utility methods for creating exception instances, with relevant metadata and annotations.

classes.name: ThingConflictException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class indicating a conflict when a 'Thing' with a given ID already exists. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, providing static factory methods and a builder pattern for instantiation.

classes.name: ThingConflictException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for creating instances of ThingConflictException with fluent API, allowing setting of message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a ThingConflictException, initialized with the given ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ThingConflictException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ThingConflictException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with the provided headers, copying other properties from the current instance.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Internal method used by the builder pattern to construct the actual ThingConflictException with set parameters.
